title: Tübatulabal language
description: Extinct Uto-Aztecan language of Kern County, California, US
extract: Tübatulabal is a Uto-Aztecan language, traditionally spoken in Kern County, California, United States. It is the traditional language of the Tübatulabal, who have switched to English. The language originally had three main dialects: Bakalanchi, Pakanapul and Palegawan.
